fact: 1905年6月30日结束的一年内，进入美国的外国移民达1026000人；罗斯福总统在1906年结集的演说中称，这一年人数超过从詹姆斯敦登陆到《独立宣言》之间169年殖民地人口之和——1905年是美国移民史高峰年之一。

sources.title: Theodore Roosevelt, A Square Deal (compilation of presidential addresses, copyright 1906; Allendale Press ed.), Project Gutenberg eBook #66890
sources.quote: In the year ending June 30, 1905, there came to the United States 1,026,000 alien immigrants. In other words, in the single year that has just elapsed there came to this country a greater number of people than came here during the one hundred and sixty-nine years of our Colonial life which intervened between the first landing at Jamestown and the Declaration of Independence.

fact: 莱特兄弟自述：飞行平衡问题的症结直到1905年9月底才完全克服，此后飞行距离迅速增长；因围观人数太多，实验在10月5日之后停止——1905年秋是人类首次实现完全受控、持续飞行并因公众兴趣过热而被迫暂停展示的时点。

sources.title: Orville Wright and Wilbur Wright, The Early History of the Airplane, Project Gutenberg eBook #25420
sources.quote: The causes of these troubles--too technical for explanation here--were not entirely overcome till the end of September, 1905. The flights then rapidly increased in length, till experiments were discontinued after October 5, on account of the number of people attracted to the field.

fact: 莱特兄弟1908年恢复试验时使用的机体即1905年西姆斯站（Simms Station）的同一架飞机，为满足美国政府合同要求（载两人、携带足够燃料飞行125英里、时速40英里）才加装座位、加大发动机与水箱油箱、改坐姿——1905年机型被证明是政府采购的合格原型。

sources.title: Orville Wright and Wilbur Wright, The Early History of the Airplane, Project Gutenberg eBook #25420
sources.quote: It was not till May of this year that experiments (discontinued in October, 1905) were resumed at Kill Devil Hill, North Carolina. The recent flights were made to test the ability of our machine to meet the requirements of a contract with the United States Government to furnish a flyer capable of carrying two men and sufficient fuel supplies for a flight of 125 miles, with a speed of 40 miles an hour. The machine used in these tests was the same one with which the flights were made at Simms Station in 1905

fact: 福特汽车公司（Ford Motor Company）成立时资本额定为10万美元，亨利·福特持股25.5%；全公司实收现金资本仅约2.8万美元，且此后再未从外部为股本金筹资。1906年，福特用公司赚得的钱买入股票使持股升至51%——这是一家未公开上市报价、靠合伙与回购完成控制权集中的私人公司样本。

sources.title: Henry Ford in collaboration with Samuel Crowther, My Life and Work, Project Gutenberg eBook #7213
sources.quote: the capitalization of the company was one hundred thousand dollars, and of this I owned 25 1/2 per cent. The total amount subscribed in cash was about twenty-eight thousand dollars--which is the only money that the company has ever received for the capital fund from other than operations. … in 1906, with funds that I had earned in the company, I bought enough stock to bring my holdings up to 51 per cent

fact: 美国自1879年起实行金币本位并持续至1917年（EH.net黄金标准国别表：United States Coin 1879-1917）；1905年美元与黄金挂钩，是国内投资与移民汇款的计价基础。

sources.title: Lawrence H. Officer, Gold Standard, EH.net Encyclopedia

fact: 1905年前后美国汽车业私人入股的实缴门槛可参照福特汽车：名义资本10万美元，实缴现金仅约2.8万美元，小股东与创始人合计投入不到3万美元即可启动一家后来改变产业的公司——私人股权参与的资本密度远低于同时代铁路与钢铁。

fact: 美国早期汽车驾驶实行市级许可：福特回忆1895—1896年驾车时‘必须取得市长特别许可，一度自诩为全美唯一持照 chauffeur（汽车司机）’——汽车相关执业资格由城市警察行政掌握，联邦层面尚无统一制度；这对1905年后汽车创业者的合规预期仍是重要背景（该引证时点为1890年代，作制度背景使用）。

sources.title: Henry Ford in collaboration with Samuel Crowther, My Life and Work, Project Gutenberg eBook #7213
